name: HAR Viewer
description: Shows .har and Playwright .har.zip files as a network log: request list, waterfall, filters and each request's headers, payload, response, cookies, timing and WebSocket frames. Copy as cURL, export an agent digest, save a masked copy. Independent; not affiliated with Playwright or any browser maker.

cover.alt: Known secrets masked, 28 values in 15 requests: the request list and waterfall, a failed POST /v1/reports/export selected.

screenshots.alt: A Markdown digest of the 4 failed requests, bodies cut to 2,000 characters and known secrets masked, to copy or save as .md.
The Errors filter keeps 4 of 29 requests, beside an overview of their types, status codes and the 2 domains they came from.
A slow request by phase: DNS 18 ms, connection 42 ms, SSL/TLS 31 ms, waiting 1.20 s, and Server-Timing's report query 1.10 s.
A 2.4 kB JSON response in Tree view, Source a click away: 20 orders, the first opened to its id, customer, total and status.
Follow one order: 4 of 19 socket messages match 48207, sent and received, one opened as JSON. Shown in Orca's light theme.
